# JakeAI machine-readable discovery

This repository file is intentionally non-commercial and non-authoritative.

Canonical runtime discovery is generated dynamically by the JakeAI backend at:
- https://www.jakeaiofficial.com/llms.txt
- https://www.jakeaiofficial.com/.well-known/agent.json

Do not use this static repository file as evidence of current product availability, pricing, settlement capability, provider readiness, or deployment state. Commercial and operational status must come from the active runtime surfaces and the canonical product registry after the applicable verification and approval gates have passed.

Public website API convention: https://www.jakeaiofficial.com/api/v1/...
Direct backend convention: /v1/...

Safety rule: capabilities requiring metering, entitlement, external-provider configuration, physical-control validation, or human commercial approval fail closed until those requirements are verified.
